title: fix(create-vite): add router only options for tanstack router/start
body:
Selecting "TanStack Router" from `vite create` will create a full framework TanStack Start app.

- Appends `--router-only` to the TanStack CLI npm command for the "TanStack Router" option
- Adds a seperate entry for "TanStack Start" without `--router-only`

AI disclouser: very small GLM 5.3 flash session used to track down and debug the issue on both vite and tanstack/cli's side. Solution is very small and explicit and I've read all of it.
